GuZhenRen:DaoTianZhenChuan.NAME: Thieving Heaven's True Inheritance
DESCRIPTIONS: While exploring the dream realm, a song suddenly lingers by your ears— NL ~"The song is sparse, the hero is down and out, hard to resist an ill-fated destiny."~ NL ~"Broken swords sink in the sand, eternal rise and fall, the endless heavenly river surges."~ NL ~"Sorrow..."~ NL ~"The dark night is long, the soul dreams are endless, asking where is the peaceful homeland?"~ NL ~"Things change, hearts shift over autumns and springs, only heaven's will is boundless."~ NL The dream realm suddenly dissipates. You jolt awake, a stream of information inexplicably flowing into your mind. This is the clue to the true inheritance of #y~Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable~ ! The unseen guidance points towards the #yCentral Continent and the #yNorthern Plains respectively.

After some twists and turns, you arrive at the location of Thieving Heaven's true inheritance in the Central Continent. NL "According to the song's instructions, I just need to activate #yOpen Door Gu to enter Thieving Heaven's true inheritance."

After some twists and turns, you arrive at the location of Thieving Heaven's true inheritance in the Northern Plains. NL "According to the song's instructions, I just need to activate #yOpen Door Gu to enter Thieving Heaven's true inheritance."

You make up your mind, activate Open Door Gu, and enter the true inheritance space. NL A magnetic male voice suddenly echoes. NL "Wanderer from afar." NL "You, like me, are a pitiful person with a home but cannot return." NL "My original name is #yBen Jie Sun , the world calls me #yThieving Heaven Demon Venerable . In truth, I am just a wandering child who wants to go home." NL "This world is like a cage of despair." NL "If you also want to go home, then accept my gift." NL "I believe it will definitely bring you help. But if you want to return to your homeland, you must rely on your own efforts!" NL "Also, the name of this gift is— #p~Divine Concealment~ ." NL The next moment, the true inheritance space vanishes, and you return to where you were.

You think twice and feel this matter is indeed fishy. NL "How could a Venerable's true inheritance be so easy to take? This is near Spirit Affinity House's territory; entering rashly will likely result in an ambush." NL "But since I'm here, I should at least plunder before leaving..." NL You decisively abandon the true inheritance, rush to the nearest Spirit Affinity House resource point, loot it thoroughly, and quickly leave the area.

You activate Open Door Gu and enter the true inheritance space. NL A magnetic male voice suddenly echoes. NL "Wanderer from afar." NL "You, like me, are a pitiful person with a home but cannot return." NL "My original name is #yBen Jie Sun , the world calls me #yThieving Heaven Demon Venerable . In truth, I am just a wandering child who wants to go home." NL "This world is like a cage of despair." NL "If you also want to go home, then accept my gift." NL "I believe it will definitely bring you help. But if you want to return to your homeland, you must rely on your own efforts!" NL "Also, the name of this gift is— #p~Ghostly Concealment~ ." NL The next moment, the true inheritance space vanishes, and you return to where you were.

You keenly realize that this place is actually the legendary secluded domain of heaven and earth— #yLuo Po Valley ! NL You think twice and feel this true inheritance reveals unpredictable strangeness. NL "Rather than risking entering the true inheritance, it's better to move the entire secluded domain directly!" NL You decisively abandon the true inheritance and fiercely activate your Strength Path methods. NL @"BOOM——!!"@ NL Amidst the earth-shattering tremor, you forcefully uproot the entire Luo Po Valley, store it in your immortal aperture, and swagger away.
Everything happened too suddenly. Perhaps this is some Wisdom Path method specifically meant to affect your mind? NL You decide to stay vigilant and not take the risk.

GuZhenRen:BaiGuChuanCheng.NAME: White Bone True Inheritance
DESCRIPTIONS: You step into a mountain range completely white, with no soil or stone around, only pale bones. NL You can faintly hear the shouts of pursuing Gu Masters behind you: NL #r" #r@Demon!@ #rYou are surrounded, you can't escape even with wings. Just come out!" NL Ignoring their clamor, relying on your past life's memory, you arrive at a hidden cave. NL Among densely packed spiral bone spikes, you accurately find the shortest one and pull it outwards. NL ~"Crack..."~ NL The cave entrance behind you instantly closes, and a long secret passage extends before you. NL "So this is the #yWhite #yBone #yTrue #yInheritance ..."

You follow the secret passage into the first hall. NL In the center of the pure white hall sits a large vat, filled with milk-like white liquid emitting bursts of enticing milky fragrance. NL Beneath this white spring water, dense numbers of #yGu #yworms are slumbering.
You fish a Gu worm out of the vat and refine it instantly. NL At the same time, strange noises echo from deep within the passage behind you...

You kick the vat to pieces, completely destroying the remaining Gu worms. NL Hearing the approaching noises from behind, you don't pause, rushing down the secret passage into the second bone hall. NL In the center of the hall stand three white bone pillars, topped with carved bone hands, each grasping a #yGu #yworm . NL A line of text is carved on the pillars: NL #b"Choose one of three, be content. White Bone Mountain inheritance, left for future generations."
You crush a bone hand to take the Gu worm. NL The remaining stone pillars still stand quietly. Do you still plan to continue taking them?

You ignore the carved warning on the pillars and forcefully snatch the last Gu worm. NL After losing the Gu worms, the three empty bone hand stone pillars finally stop standing still. Accompanied by the roar of mechanisms, they slowly sink into the ground, leaving no trace.

You arrive at the third hall. NL A human skeleton sits cross-legged by the cave wall, with an arm-length grey bone giant book placed in front of it. NL You flip open the book, which records many Gu refinement recipes, as well as the life story of the inheritance's owner— #yGrey #yBone #yScholar . NL The book concludes: NL "This skeleton is Grey Bone Scholar himself. If future fated ones have the heart, they might as well pay their respects and kowtow three times. After paying respects, split the skeleton's skull to see a Gu. This Gu is his #yVital #yGu ; whoever obtains it must ~benefit the world and uphold justice~ ."

You step forward and raise your foot, crushing the skeleton's skull! NL You extract Grey Bone Scholar's vital Gu, the #yBone #ySpike #yGu , from the cracked skull. NL The shouts of the pursuing enemies behind you are already clearly audible.

You walk down the descending grey bone stairs for thousands of meters. In the darkness, a tightly shut door appears before you. NL Four large words are carved on the door— #yFlesh #ySac #ySecret #yPavilion . NL You push the door and enter. The walls around you are all made of flesh. The flesh walls are covered with countless mouths, revealing rows of white teeth. NL #r~"Hee hee hee... Hahaha... Hehehe..."~ NL Various laughs mix together, echoing in the narrow pavilion. NL According to records, these mouths, transformed by the #yFlesh #ySmile #yGu , are containers used to store Gu worms.

You bend your finger and knock on the teeth of a large mouth. NL This mouth's laughter abruptly stops, and its teeth all fall out. A bright red, long tongue stretches forward, spitting out a #yGu #yworm towards you.

You follow the secret passage to the end of the inheritance, only to find a sheer cliff outside the exit! NL The tight sound of footsteps comes from behind as the Gu Masters aggressively pursue and completely block you at the edge of the cliff.

You ran all the way, not stopping at any checkpoints. To force you to stop, the pursuers frantically unleashed ranged killer moves in the narrow secret passage. NL With a loud "@Boom!@", the bone ground beneath your feet was forcibly blown apart, and you plunged fiercely into the abyss.

You climb up and find yourself fallen into a deep, secluded #ysecret #yroom . NL "What's going on?" NL You are deeply shaken. Relying on five hundred years of memories from your past life, you know the ins and outs of the White Bone True Inheritance perfectly, but this secret room is completely outside your memories.

In the center of the secret room quietly stands a giant Gu worm flowing with ~chilling bone light~ — the #yBattle #yBone #yWheel #yGu . NL When you place your palm on the wheel, a stream of information instantly flows into your mind. This is actually the peak mortal killer move, #y@White Bone Chariot@ ! NL "This killer move was uniquely created by the rank eight demonic path Gu Immortal #yShen #yJie #yAo , and its might can rival a rank six Immortal Gu. To think that Grey Bone Scholar, a mere rank four Gu Master, could hide it here. What a great method!" you secretly praise in your heart.

Pursuers have already poked their heads out of the gap above. You decisively activate the newly acquired Battle Bone Wheel Gu. NL The giant pale bone wheel, carrying frantic bone spikes and fierce winds, @spins@ at high speed, forcibly @crushing@ a passage through the mountain body. It breaks through the wall and takes you away, completely leaving the dumbfounded pursuers behind.
You delayed too long during your looting, and the pursuers finally surged out like a tide, completely surrounding you! NL You have nowhere to hide and must fight!

Although you repelled this wave of enemies, your primeval essence is severely depleted, and your condition is extremely poor. NL Worse still, more pursuers are arriving from behind, their battle cries shaking the heavens and earth. NL You ignore looting the spoils of war and, under the cover of the dust kicked up by the battle, quickly flee the area.

Outnumbered, fighting head-on offers no chance of survival. NL You grit your teeth and frantically activate your Gu worms at all costs, forcefully tearing open a gap in the encirclement to escape amidst a barrage of attacks. NL Although you successfully broke out, you suffered extremely heavy injuries as a result.

Jumping from this height is absolutely certain death, but you have no other choice and jump off the cliff fiercely. NL During the rapid descent, you desperately activate defensive methods, successively smashing through countless thick bone branches protruding from the cliff face to continuously slow your fall. NL Finally, you crash heavily to the bottom of the valley, narrowly saving your life, and escape into the deep forest to avoid the search.

You leap off the cliff and summon the #yFootless #yBird in mid-air. NL In the split second before crashing, the Footless Bird frantically flaps its wings, charging upwards against the extreme wind pressure! NL You ride the giant bird across the sky, flying far away, leaving behind a group of Gu masters at the cliff edge watching you leave with ashen faces.
OPTIONS: [Explore] #gObtain #gBattle Bone Wheel and #gKiller Move - White Bone Chariot .

GuZhenRen:DuShiChang.NAME: Rock Gambling Den
DESCRIPTIONS: You pass by a large grey tent. A couplet is carved on the pillars at the entrance: NL First line: "A little courage brings the fortune of four seasons." NL Second line: "Show your skills to harvest the wealth of all directions." NL Horizontal scroll: "A turn of luck." NL Lifting the door curtain, the inside of the tent is very deserted. Many stones are scattered on the long tables in the venue, divided into three counters according to their appearance. The only clerk is fast asleep on the table, completely unresponsive to your arrival.
You toss out a few gold coins, pick a stone, and crush it. A perfectly intact Gu worm is revealed in the stone powder.
You toss out a few gold coins, pick a stone, and crush it. Apart from a pile of grey-white stone powder, there is nothing else.
You pick a piece of purple gold stone and grind it down. As the stone core peels off, a Gu worm is revealed.
You pick a piece of purple gold stone and grind it down. As the last bit of stone flesh turns to dust, you confirm this is just a solid waste rock.
You pick a nice-looking stone and grind it down. The stone skin fades away, and a Gu worm is presented before you.
You pick a nice-looking stone and grind it down. Although the exterior is extraordinary, there is nothing inside.
You turn around and walk out of this deserted rock gambling den.

[Regular Counter] #rLose #r10 #rGold . #g%d%%: Obtain a random Uncommon Gu relic.%s
[High-grade Counter] #rLose #r15 #rGold . #g%d%%: Obtain a random Rare Gu relic.%s

GuZhenRen:NiLiuHeEvent.NAME: Reverse Flow River
DESCRIPTIONS: @"Splash——!"@ NL A surging wave appears out of nowhere, instantly submerging you. When you surface, you find yourself swept into a broad, turbulent river. NL "This is— #yReverse #yFlow #yRiver ?!" NL With your extensive knowledge, you immediately recognize the origin of the river you are in. NL In this #bReverse #bFlow #bRiver #bwater , no Gu worms can be activated; you can only rely on your own strength to swim forward. NL On the river surface ahead of you, many lives are also swimming: other Gu Immortals, a large number of wild beasts, vegetation, and even stones.
The Reverse Flow River water is extremely turbulent, with various swept-in debris floating on the surface. NL You face the current and swim forward.
The river surface around you gradually calms down, but the resistance to move forward grows stronger. NL You still persevere, advancing towards the upper reaches.

~The Reverse Flow River flows quietly.~ NL The further upstream, the calmer the river surface. But the river water seems to flow into your heart, stirring up #btens #bof #bthousands #bof #bwaves , silently reversing your thought of continuing forward.
~The Reverse Flow River flows quietly.~ NL All other #ytrudgers have been washed out by the river water, and there is no longer any figure ahead of you. NL On the calm river surface, only you remain.
The Reverse Flow River water becomes shallower. NL While swimming, your soles suddenly touch solid ground. NL You stand up from the river water, step by step #b~continuing~ #b~forward~ .

The Reverse Flow River water becomes shallower. NL Seeing that you are about to step out of the river. But just as you take the final step, the Reverse Flow River water also rises by a small margin. NL For every step you take, the Reverse Flow River smoothly #bflows #bforward #bone #bstep , keeping you always within the river. NL #r~The Reverse Flow River has no end.~
~Step by step.~ NL The Reverse Flow River has no end, but you pay no mind to it. NL Your gaze remains clear, still #bexpressionless . NL You continue walking forward. NL ~Step by step.~

As time passes, you are still ~constantly moving forward~ . NL The expressions of the Gu Immortals outside the river gradually change. NL "This is the aura of a #bGu #bworm ? But it seems somewhat different!" NL "Something's wrong. This isn't the aura of an Immortal Gu, or rather it's incomplete, how strange!" NL "Looking at this situation, he is #y~refining~ #y~Gu~ !" NL You also feel the profound changes within your body. With your every step forward, the aura inside you seems to grow a fraction stronger.
Just as the thought of giving up arises, you instantly lose all forward momentum. NL The next moment, you are rapidly washed out by the Reverse Flow River water.
A severely injured Gu Immortal is washed down by the current, floating right in front of you. His eyes roll back, making his final struggle in the water.
You take the opportunity to press him to the bottom of the water, ending his life. NL You quickly search his corpse, but only find some money.
You take the opportunity to press him to the bottom of the water, but his dying counterattack also causes you some injuries. NL You quickly search his corpse, but only find some money.
You encounter a hostile Gu Immortal. Unable to activate Gu worms, he can only swing his fists at you in the water, blocking your advance.
You exchange blows with him, engaging in close combat in the water, trading fleshy punches for a few rounds.

Finding a flaw, you ruthlessly pierce his eyes with two fingers. NL Suffering a heavy blow, a large amount of #rblood sprays ~out~ from his eye sockets. You press the advantage and strike ruthlessly again. The blocking Gu Immortal finally stops moving, remaining perfectly still. NL He is dead.

You bump into a #prank #beight #bGu #bImmortal . Although equally unable to use Gu worms, his dao mark foundation is profound, and his water combat experience is rich, far beyond ordinary Gu Immortals. NL Fortunately, he doesn't seem to want to attack you actively.
You exchange blows in the river water, fists and palms colliding, grappling in close quarters for a few rounds.

Finding a flaw, you viciously @kick@ him in the crotch! NL His face instantly stiffens, eyes bulging, painfully spitting out a large string of bubbles. You continue to @viciously kick@ his #rvitals . This rank eight great expert finally stops struggling, slowly sinking to the bottom of the river.

A giant piece of driftwood drifts down the turbulent river, upon which lies a #bmulticolored #bgiant #btiger . This driftwood is very suitable for a short rest, but it obviously cannot bear the weight of one person and one tiger.
With a few heavy punches, you beat the giant tiger to death and kick it into the water, lying on the driftwood gasping for air, replenishing some stamina.

With a few heavy punches, you beat the giant tiger to death, but its violent thrashing before death crushes the already overwhelmed driftwood. NL Broken wood and the dead tiger both ~sink into the water~ , and your wish to rest goes unfulfilled.
In the river water ahead, you see a tiny object drifting down, ~bobbing~ not far from you. It seems to be a #yGu #bworm .
You deviate from your route to swim over, grabbing the slumbering Gu worm.
A pale young Gu Immortal's corpse drifts down the current, seemingly clutching something in his hand.
You deviate from your route to swim over, snatching the item from the corpse's hand.
Driven by the rapid and turbulent current, a hill-sized giant stone crashes straight towards you!
You cross your arms to guard your front. The giant stone heavily smashes into you, the immense impact causing your qi and blood to surge.
You take a deep breath and ruthlessly smash a heavy punch into the giant stone! NL The stone splinters in the water, but the massive recoil also leaves your body numb.
You use the current to avoid the frontal impact of the giant stone, but its sharp edges still scrape across your body, leaving a deep gash.
The riverbed terrain suddenly changes, and you are caught off guard, swept into a giant underwater whirlpool!
You desperately swim out of the whirlpool. During the struggle against the undercurrent, the immense water impact causes you some injuries, but fortunately, there are no other losses.
You desperately swim out of the whirlpool. The immense water impact injures you, and your #y%s is also swept away by the water in the chaos.

"Why is he #bexpressionless ?" an unknown Gu Immortal suddenly asks. NL Besides you, the other trudgers are either #g~twisting their expressions~ , in #r@extreme agony@ , #y@insane@ , or #p~weeping~ . NL Why are you always #b~expressionless~ ? NL "Why can he persist for so long? Furthermore, he seems able to persist even longer, as if he could keep going forever!" NL No one can answer this question. The immortals are speechless, just watching you ~walk forward step by step~ .

As you continue to move forward, the aura of the #yGu #bworm within your body continuously strengthens, reaching the @pinnacle@ . NL From the inside out, your body begins to emit a ~pure white radiance~ . NL You remain expressionless, no matter how many steps you take, the Reverse Flow River will always flow beneath your feet, as if it's the utmost mockery of fate. NL ~But you still keep walking.~ NL You have walked from your previous five hundred years of life, not knowing how much longer you have to walk. NL But you know exactly where you want to go.

You still remain expressionless, moving forward without being swayed in the slightest. NL "I had once screamed, gradually, I lost my voice." NL "I had once cried, gradually, I lost my tears." NL "I had once grieved, gradually, I became able to withstand everything." NL "I had once rejoiced, gradually, I became unmoved by the world." NL "And now! All I have left is an #bexpressionless face, my gaze is as tough as a monolith, only perseverance remains in my heart." NL "This is my own, an insignificant character, Fang Yuan's— #y~Perseverance~ !" NL A sudden burst of light, blinding to the eyes. NL #yPerseverance #yImmortal #yGu , at this moment, is refined @!!!@

The moment Perseverance Immortal Gu is refined, the #yReverse #bFlow #bRiver gently #bflows around your feet like a docile cat or dog. The immense pressure that previously burdened you completely ~vanishes into thin air~ . NL You stop in your tracks, standing still, the Reverse Flow River no longer washing over you. NL You find that you can already use Gu worms within the river.

You extend your palm, aiming at the river surface below, and clench slightly. NL "Rise." NL The entire segment of the Reverse Flow River slowly floats up, blossoming with a #bpale blue radiance . NL The blue light surges, like ~rolling clouds~ , like ~surging waves~ . NL Subsequently, the blue light condenses, the massive Reverse Flow River disappears, shrinking entirely to your side, turning into a pale blue robe. NL Immortal killer move— #yMyriad #ySelf #ySecond #yStyle — #b~Reverse Flow Protection Seal~ ! NL Adorned in the flowing snow robe, immune to all methods. You effortlessly ~reverse~ all the incoming attacks from the surrounding Gu Immortals, swaggering away under everyone's shocked gazes.

You stay in the river to quietly recuperate, the various forces on the outside dare not make a move, resulting in a stalemate. NL As time passes, the Gu Immortals of different factions outside the river finally lose their patience, breaking out into a chaotic melee, fighting until heaven and earth are overturned. NL You observe coldly for a while, then take advantage of the chaos to escape during the melee.
OPTIONS: [Deduce Killer Move] #rLose #r[Wan Lan]. #gObtain #g[Reverse Flow Protection Seal].
